Tech Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the following decisions taken at the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company held on January 23, 2009: The Company would be seeking consent of shareholders for amending its Articles of Association for increasing the number of directors, by postal ballot in accordance with Section 192A of the Companies Act, 1956 read with the Companies (Passing of the Resolution by Postal Ballot) Rules, 2001.
